sentences.text:
Author: Suvra Ghosh
Bench: Suvra Ghosh
17
jdt.
 17.05.2023
 jb.
 W.P.A. 2698 of 2023
 Mr. Rabiul Islam
 Mr. Raju Mondal
 .... For the Petitioners
 Mr. Chandi Charan De
 Mr. Anirban Sarkar
 .... For the State

It is not in dispute that the land of the petitioners  has been utilised by the PHE Department without  acquisition and the Department is ready and willing to  purchase the land from the petitioners in terms of the  direct land purchase policy of the Government.

It is submitted on behalf of the respondents that since Rules under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 have not been framed as yet, no step can be taken for acquisition of the land in question at present.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners seeks to take necessary instruction in the matter.
Let the matter appear under the same heading on 22nd June, 2023.

(Suvra Ghosh, J.)
WPA/2698/2023 on 17 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/153899126/
